meta.name: debug
meta.description: Debug container agent issues. Use when things aren't working, container fails, authentication problems, or to understand how the container system works. Covers logs, session DBs, mounts, and common issues.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 排查容器和 agent 运行问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到容器或 agent 运行异常需要定位根因
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to diagnose container or agent runtime problems

howto.what: 容器代理出问题时,Claude 会检查日志、会话数据库和挂载点,定位重复实例、认证失败、挂载错误等故障并给出修复命令;也能解释容器系统工作原理。
howto.when: 当用户说「容器失败」「消息未送达」「认证错误」,或想了解容器系统怎么工作时,就会触发。

say.text: 容器没反应,帮我查一下日志。
消息发出去了但对方没收到,哪儿出了问题?
say.note: Claude 会检查会话数据库和投递记录。
Claude 会检查 secret 模式和网关状态。

howto.what_en: Claude uses this skill to debug container agent issues: checks logs, session DBs, and mounts, identifies common causes (duplicate instances, auth failures, mount errors), and provides fixes. It also explains how the container system works.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user reports container failures, undelivered messages, or auth errors, or asks how the container system works.

say_en.text: The container is unresponsive; please check the logs.
say_en.note: Claude will start with error logs.

say_en.text: A message was sent but never received; what could be wrong?
Authentication failed; how do I troubleshoot?
say_en.note: Claude will check secret mode and gateway.
